title: Crestline Fleet Account Counter Authorization, Purchase Order and Approval Limit Schedule
content:
These are the program figures a store counter works to when a ticket is charged to a Crestline Fleet Account. Amounts are in USD.

## Purchase order threshold and ticket approval limit

| Program | Ticket amount (pre-tax, after discount) at or above which a purchase order number is required | Program default for the largest ticket completed without the fleet manager's approval |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 250.00 | 750.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 0.00 | 1000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 0.00 | 1500.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 0.00 | 2500.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 0.00 | 1000.00 |

A purchase order threshold of 0.00 means a purchase order number is required on every ticket.

## Account-level approval limit

On every program the account's own ticket approval limit relates to the program default in one way only: the fleet manager may lower it, never raise it above the default.

## What a driver gives at the counter

| Program | To charge the account, the driver gives |
|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | the unit number and the driver's name |
| Crestline Fleet Business | the unit number and the driver's name |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | the unit number and the driver's PIN |
| Crestline Fleet National | the unit number and the driver's PIN |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | the unit number and the driver's PIN |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | the unit number and a purchase order |

## Threshold cases (hypothetical tickets)

- On Crestline Fleet Business, a ticket of 249.99 before tax and after discount is below the 250.00 threshold; a ticket of exactly 250.00 is at it, so a purchase order number is required.
- On Crestline Fleet Starter, a ticket of exactly 500.00 needs a purchase order number, because the requirement starts at the threshold itself.
